integrity.computational_role: The bundled checker verifies the explicit Jacobian calculation and weighted-degree separation; it does not replace the semiquasihomogeneous invariance theorem or Milnor's bouquet theorem.
integrity.critical_source_input: Burek's Lemma 4.1 and Proposition 4.2 give the weighted initial forms at all six points; Remark 8.4 computes the distinct surface-fiber Milnor number 9.

scientific_limitations: The statement is local over the complex numbers and concerns only the six isolated singularities of the explicit anticanonical quartic threefold.
No global smoothing of the singular threefold is asserted.
The equality of Milnor numbers for the exact germ and its weighted initial form uses the standard semiquasihomogeneous invariance theorem.
title: The six isolated Calabi--Yau singularities have Milnor number \(27\)
